title: Patterns
comment: Ten thousand dots, each one drawn by chance: a hundred events with no
position given; ten thousand; x from a bell curve and y from a beta; i, the
index, with no chance at all; and in a sound, each event a note (the forty
bells you hear are the forty dots, through `notes`). The dots are this
draws: pattern d4 = repeat 3000 event(x: ~normal(0.5, 0.1), y: ~beta(2, 5), size: 0.004)
pattern d5 = repeat 100 event(x: i / n, y: 0.5 + sin(i / 8) / 3, size: 0.012)
pattern d6 = repeat 40 event(x: i / n, t: (43.95 + i / n * 4) / total, y: ~beta(2, 5), size: 0.012)

sections.name: the hook
sections.label: patterns
sections.say: Ten thousand dots, each one drawn by chance.
stage: let hk1 = text("08  ·  patterns", x: 0.5, y: 0.74, size: 0.036, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hk2 = text("alea, one feature at a time", x: 0.5, y: 0.81, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hookf = max(wave * RED, max(hk1 * INK, hk2 * GREY))

sections.name: a hundred events, each one drawn
sections.label: a hundred
sections.say: A hundred events. No position given: each one is drawn.
stage: let r2 = clamp(move(zoom(d2, 0.5), 0, 0.35), 0, 1) * inside * (T >= 10.7)
let s2f = max(k2_code, max(fr2 * RULE, r2 * INK))

sections.name: ten thousand, another ten thousand every run
sections.label: ten thousand
sections.say: Ten thousand. Every run, another ten thousand.
stage: let r3 = clamp(move(zoom(d3, 0.5), 0, 0.35), 0, 1) * inside * (T >= 18.7)
let s3f = max(k3_code, max(fr3 * RULE, r3 * INK))

sections.name: x from a bell curve, y from a beta
sections.label: a shape
sections.say: x from a bell curve, y from a beta: chance has a shape.
stage: let r4 = clamp(move(zoom(d4, 0.5), 0, 0.35), 0, 1) * inside * (T >= 26.7)
let s4f = max(k4_code, max(fr4 * RULE, r4 * INK))

sections.name: no chance: i, the event's index
sections.label: the index
sections.say: Or no chance at all: i is the event's index.
stage: let r5 = clamp(move(zoom(d5, 0.5), 0, 0.35), 0, 1) * inside * (T >= 35.7)
let s5f = max(k5_code, max(fr5 * RULE, r5 * INK))

sections.name: in a sound, each event a note
sections.label: a sound
sections.say: In a sound, each event is a note.

lines: event(x: i / n, t: i / n, y: ~beta(2, 5))

stage: let r6 = clamp(move(zoom(d6, 0.5), 0, 0.35), 0, 1) * inside * (T >= 43.95)
let s6f = max(k6_code, max(fr6 * RULE, max(r6 * INK, ph6 * RED)))

sections.name: the end
sections.say: Next week: growing. Cells that live, die, and leave a trace.

lines: event(x: i / n, t: i / n, y: ~beta(2, 5))

stage: let nsize = 0.2
let nadv = 0.5172 * nsize
let nx0e = 0.5 - 2.5 * nadv
let name2 = text("alea", x: nx0e, y: 0.64, size: nsize, font: "mono", align: "left") * (T >= 53.8)
let ecur = (abs(x - (nx0e + 4.5 * nadv)) < nadv * 0.42) * (abs(y - 0.64) < nsize * 0.4) * blink * (T >= 53.8)
let e1 = text("one feature at a time  ·  08  ·  patterns", x: 0.5, y: 0.78, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 54.3)
let e2 = text("alea.bngz.io", x: 0.5, y: 0.89, size: 0.06, font: "mono") * (T >= 54.8)
let e3 = text("next  ·  09  ·  growing", x: 0.5, y: 1.02, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= l7.words[2])
let e4 = text("open source  ·  github.com/sudo-bngz/alea", x: 0.5, y: 1.1, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 55.8)
let endf = max(k7_code, max(name2 * INK, max(ecur * RED, max(e1 * INK, max(e2 * RED, max(e3 * GREY, e4 * INK))))))
